description: Boolean logic applied across the channels of one polyphonic input, with six monophonic gate outputs

params.text: NORM makes the XOR and XNOR outputs answer to an odd number of high input channels; 1-HOT makes them answer only when exactly one channel is high

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal the logic runs on; a channel counts as high over 2V and stays high until it falls below 0.1V, and the STATE matrix shows which channels are high

outputs.text: 10V while every channel of the input is high, 0V otherwise
10V while at least one channel of the input is high, 0V while all of them are low
10V when an odd number of the input channels is high, or when exactly one is high with XOR MODE set to 1-HOT; 0V otherwise
0V while every channel of the input is high, 10V otherwise
0V while at least one channel of the input is high, 10V while all of them are low
0V when an odd number of the input channels is high, or when exactly one is high with XOR MODE set to 1-HOT; 10V otherwise

notes: with nothing patched to the input, AND, OR and XOR rest at 0V and NAND, NOR and XNOR at 10V
